title: Audit any solver's plan the way HiGHS's report does
heading: SCIP Says When Its Best Solution Breaks a Row of Your Model
cases: a plan inside every bound, whole and within every row reports three zeros, and a plan over an upper bound, off a whole number and over a row reports the largest of each
a binary just below 1 is that far from 1, not from 0
a continuous variable may take any value; only integer variables are checked
a value below its lower bound, and a row below its lower side, are violations too
